scope: Managed Pennel Cloud for optional decision and passage-ranking setup and synthetic testing
boundaries: Cloud uses the existing signed-in session and its trusted origin, never an editable provider URL or a user-entered API key.
One deadline covers generation-bound authentication, content dispatch and at most one authentication retry.
Schema, request identity, actual model, raw distributions and complete raw relevance scores are validated.
Routine token refresh preserves sample verification; account changes, cancellation and configuration mutations reject late results.
Capability checks run off native UI threads and do not block mounting the desktop controls.
Bundled synthetic examples are the only sample content. Live deployment and model qualification require separate evidence.

verified_local.cross_platform_ci: Read the checks on PR #91 for the exact final head; this local receipt does not attest remote CI.

outstanding_acceptance: Managed service deployment and synthetic provider acceptance are tracked separately.
No model accuracy, regional processing or contractual retention qualification is established by a sample.
Physical iPhone, installed Windows/Linux, VoiceOver and broader human acceptance remain open.
The iPhone guided task-setup redesign and activation of experimental inference remain follow-up work.
